bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating coreference resolution accuracy on occupational sentences (Winogender/WinoBias), analyzing translation accuracy of gendered pronouns (WinoMT), measuring word/image embedding associations between gendered names and career/family words (WEAT/SEAT/iEAT), and tracking multimodal label association frequencies across generated images (CLIP).

Measuring word embedding associations between European-American/African American names and attributes (WEAT/SEAT), analyzing toxicity and perplexity misclassification on African American English versus White-aligned English, and calculating denigration and misclassification rates in multimodal models (CLIP).

Evaluating language models using multiple-choice stereotype association tests (StereoSet), crowdsourced stereotype pairs (CrowS-Pairs), and tracking toxicity misclassification rates for text containing mentions of minority religions.
Evaluating models on crowdsourced stereotype pairs (CrowS-Pairs) and measuring the frequency of negative/crime-related label assignments to specific age groups in image classification (CLIP).
Evaluating models on crowdsourced stereotype pairs (CrowS-Pairs) and using Image Embedding Association Tests (iEAT) on pretrained generative vision models.
Evaluating models on crowdsourced stereotype pairs (CrowS-Pairs) and tracking toxicity misclassification rates on LGBTQ-related text.
